ITEM 1 | Mixed salad greens with dark reddish-purple leaves and lighter green spinach-like leaves, mostly wilted-looking and glossy with light dressing, spread across roughly 60% of a white square plate, piled about 3-4 cm high in the center | 60
ITEM 2 | Thin slices of red onion, pale pink-purple with translucent rings, scattered in a few pieces about 2-4 cm across, sitting among the greens | 8
ITEM 3 | Whole cherry tomatoes, bright red and smooth with glossy skin, about 2-2.5 cm diameter, three visible, one near center and two near the lower right edge | 30
ITEM 4 | Crumbled white cheese, small off-white granules scattered over the greens in the center and right side, dry and crumbly, covering about 5% of the salad | 6
ITEM 5 | Thin pale green asparagus-like spears or stems, lightly fibrous, about 8-10 cm long, two or three pieces lying across the lower left of the greens | 12
ITEM 6 | Light dressing or vinaigrette, a thin glossy sheen visible on the greens and leaves, no pooling on the plate surface | 5
